# Security Policy

## Supported state

GoreeCloud PDF Manager is currently in the **Forge** lifecycle. It is under active development and is not yet production-qualified.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use GitHub **private vulnerability reporting** for `GoreeCloud/pdf-manager`. Do not publish exploit details, sensitive documents, credentials, secrets, or other confidential material in a public issue.

When reporting, include the affected revision, deployment context, reproduction conditions, and the minimum sample needed to demonstrate the issue. Do not upload real private documents when a synthetic reproducer is sufficient.

## Security expectations

PDF and document inputs are treated as hostile. Security fixes may take precedence over ordinary feature work. Critical issues may block merge, deployment, release qualification, or continued distribution until the relevant risk is contained and verified.

See `docs/SECURITY.md` for the current product security boundary and open release blockers.
